pr_title: Allow custom columns in cli dags list
pr_body:
This closes #34765

This adds an additional optional parameter `columns` to the cli command `airflow dags list`.

Examples: 

```bash
root@2cce825aa9b1:/opt/airflow# airflow dags list
dag_id      | is_paused | fileloc             | owners
============+===========+=====================+========
my_dag_name | True      | /files/dags/test.py | airflow
```

```bash
root@2cce825aa9b1:/opt/airflow# airflow dags list --columns dag_id,last_parsed_time
dag_id      | last_parsed_time
============+=================================
my_dag_name | 2023-10-30T03:34:20.148064+00:00
```

Note: Will have a follow up pr to minimize database calls
pr_comments:
@hussein-awala Thank you for your comments!

I think both are good suggestions and pushed some changes to reflect them. 

1. I changed the parameter to just columns with default values
2. I raised a ~system exit~ warning if there are invalid columns provided and ignores these columns

I just want to note the default behavior of `airflow dag list` in my implementation has changed a bit. Specifically the column names are now using the fields of the the dag schema rather than previous column names. Do you think we should alias these to the previous column names for backward compatibility? 

Before

```
root@2cce825aa9b1:/opt/airflow# airflow dags list
dag_id      | filepath | owner   | paused
============+==========+=========+=======
my_dag_name | test.py  | airflow | True
```

After

```
root@2cce825aa9b1:/opt/airflow# airflow dags list
dag_id      | fileloc             | owners  | is_paused
============+=====================+=========+==========
my_dag_name | /files/dags/test.py | airflow | True
```
Merged the suggestions and fixed the tests !
Awesome work, congrats on your first merged pull request! You are invited to check our [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues) for additional contributions.
Hi @jtmiclat you've mentioned 'Note: Will have a follow up pr to minimize database calls', was that done as well ?
Hi @sidrahsayyad I haven't worked on it

issue_context.title: need to run airflow cli command "airflow dags details" for multiple DAG IDs
issue_context.body:
### Description

Hello Team,

Hope you are doing well!

We have one use case where we want to check last parsed time for the multiple DAGs. Currently we have one airflow cli command i.e "airflow dags details" which gives the output for only one DAG ID but we want same result of this cli command for multiple DAG IDs.

We would you like to request you to create similar or modify the same cli command for giving last parsed time for multiple tasks.


Thanks & Regards,
Vidya Panchal 

### Use case/motivation

cli command : airflow dags details ----> give as output for only one DAG ID/DAG name.

We want "airflow dags details" cli command also give result for multiple DAG IDs / DAG names. 

### Related issues

We have one business use case where we want to fetch last parsed time for multiple DAGs and perform our business operations accordingly. 

### Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes I am willing to submit a PR!

### Code of Conduct

- [X] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
comments: I'm happy to pick this up if we want to move forward with this suggestion.
Maybe better to add this as output for `airflow dags list` ?

I agree adding to `airflow dags list` as additional optional column makes a good sense. Feel free to contribute, probably a good small contribution, entry point could be `airflow/cli/commands/dag_command.py:dag_list_dags()` and adding a new CLI parameter
Thank you for acknowledging it. Can we also have similar implementation for REST API where we get DAGs parsing details for multiple DAGs in single API call?

Team,

Any update on this task ? We need to get the last parsed time information of multiple DAGs at the same time. Right now this would mean running the CLI command multiple times with different DAG IDs. This enhancement will prevent the multiple command executions. Also, as Vidya mentioned, we need similar support in the REST API as well.

Regards,
Sidrah.

Hi @sidrahsayyad you are polling for status in an Open Source project. You know that people contribute to this sometimes as full time job but mostly in spare time or as side business? There is no SLA behind a feature request.

If you are under pressure then please arrange a support agreement with a commercial vendor to support you on this or feel free to contribute.

Airflow does not provide an SLA for having requested features being implemented.
